source_name: EGRPO — Unified State Register of Enterprises and Organizations (data.egov.uz / stat.uz)
organization: Statistics Agency under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan (stat.uz); open-data portal data.egov.uz
notes: The authoritative Uzbek company register is the EGRPO (Unified State Register of Enterprises and Organizations / ЕГРПО), maintained by the Statistics Agency (stat.uz) and published via the national open-data portal data.egov.uz. From THIS environment both data.egov.uz and data.gov.uz are FIREWALLED (HTTPS timeout; HTTP connection refused) — NOT reachable; stat.uz is reachable but links out to the firewalled data.egov.uz. Documented from public knowledge only; nothing captured. Key = STIR/INN (9-digit taxpayer id) + EGRPO statistical code; activity = OKED. Director is personal data. Re-check from an unblocked network.

organization: State Tax Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan (soliq.uz)
notes: The State Tax Committee provides taxpayer search by STIR/INN (and a VAT-payers registry). From this environment soliq.uz TIMED OUT (firewalled) — not reachable. Documented from public knowledge; nothing captured. Identifier = STIR/INN (9-digit). Complements EGRPO with tax/VAT status. Re-check from an unblocked network.

The Republican Stock Exchange 'Toshkent' lists issuers/securities. Reachable; /issuers/ returns a small (~11 KB) SPA shell — issuer data is loaded client-side and the JSON API path was not found (uzse.uz/api/... returns JSON 404 for guessed paths, confirming a REST backend exists). Browser-public but not cleanly automatable from here. Listed companies only.

organization: Statistics Agency under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan
notes: Statistics Agency — the custodian of the EGRPO register. Reachable; publishes statistics and links to the open-data portal data.egov.uz (firewalled from here). Holds an ODI-certified business dataset (theodi.org/datasets/221261). Useful as the entry point to the EGRPO register, but the register itself is served via the firewalled data.egov.uz. Not a direct per-company download here.
